quote: Bernardo Recamán Santos sent a letter to N. J. A. Sloane dated January 29, 1991, introducing the sequence; the conjecture was posed by Neil Sloane in 1991
note: The sequence itself was defined by Bernardo Recamán in January 1991 via correspondence with Sloane. The specific question about whether every nonnegative integer appears in the sequence was posed as a conjecture by Neil Sloane in 1991.
